verdict.rationale: Dagster documents a Dagster+ MCP server that lets AI sessions access information and take actions in a deployment, plus an official 'dagster-expert' AI skill giving coding agents context/patterns for building Dagster projects — both enabling natural-language-driven operation via agent tooling. However this is scoped to Dagster+ (not OSS) and to building/scaffolding rather than full operational control, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence of the MCP server's real-world reliability. Missing for 10: evidence of NL-driven control in the open-source product, independent corroboration of MCP server capabilities, and broader coverage of operational actions (not just building/scaffolding).
